note: Exact replacements for deliberate drawing changes merged after I1's single-sheet oracle. Each case keeps every format exact; the stream that changed it is named in streams. Applied after known_single_sheet_main_pins.json.

f2-surface-texture.note: F2 (#18): an AP242 part-wide surface texture (ISO 10303-1110) is the default finish: its ISO 1302 symbol and 'Ra 3.2' are drawn beside the title block, and the pmi_not_extracted problems for the read textures go (hw_every_kind's face texture is refused instead: its face is neither planar nor cylindrical). Plan diff: one requirement added, the not-projected problems replaced, sheet fill/basis; SVG diff: the symbol's three strokes, its glyphs and its text run only. macOS PNG hashes recorded; Linux PNG (and hw_every_kind's Linux pdf/svg, whose stale platform override is removed) to be recorded by CI's record_single_sheet job.

f4-page-fit-projection.note: #13: a pinned sheet and scale are judged as the automatic search judges its candidates. 102 cases lose page_fit_uncertain because their finished drawing's items and views all fit the sheet (pinned placements on the canonical sheet, GRM-03 at A3/A4 10:1, mounting_plate at A3 2:1 and A4 1:1, ...); 51 keep it and gain a fix (the nearest size and/or scale that fits) and its message clause. Only the plan changes: before/after plans differ in that one problem (and, where withdrawn, the basis clause 'the views may not fit' becoming 'the finished drawing fits'); SVG, PDF and PNG are byte-identical. Linux plan overrides for 62 of these cases need re-recording with record_single_sheet.

g3-draw-assembly-part.note: The D4 warning assembly_drawn_whole: an assembly drawn whole (no part chosen) gains one plan problem naming its parts. Only the plan changes; SVG, PDF and PNG are byte-identical. Plan hashes re-recorded on the f3-problem-language merge (its problem wording applies to these plans too).

rebaseline.note: known_single_sheet.json was re-recorded whole for this change; the main pins and these streams' replacements were folded into it.

j2-fix-relayout.note: #32: an explicit side/lane re-runs its side's stack spacing, a linear label at along 'outside' sits just past its line's far end, and dimension_line_shared / dimension_text_stray are reported. Saved specs only (default output byte-identical). 89 cases are plan-only: the new dimension_line_shared error on two pinned items sharing one line (SVG/PDF/PNG identical). 29 cases move an explicitly laned dimension that shared a line with another to a lane of its own (10127 hole:2 location.z and step height, ctc01/ap242 slot:2 location, mounting_plate hole:4 x, and knock-on leader/label settles); checked by eye before/after. Re-approved on the merged tree after J1's re-baseline (macOS record run); plan-only cases keep their Linux PNG, drawing changes need CI's record_single_sheet for Linux.

j3-shaft-fits.note: J3 (#30): an AP242 shaft fit stated as a class alone (LIMITS_AND_FITS('g','shaft','6') etc.) is printed on the turned diameter that states its size, with its ISO 286 limits, as a hole fit is on its bore's callout: hw_spool_fits_intent's 2× ø130 gains 'g6 (-0.014/-0.039)' and its ø70 OD 'f7 (-0.030/-0.060)', hw_thumbwheel_thread_knurl_intent's ø10 'f7 (-0.013/-0.028)', and their 'stated without limits' pmi_not_lowered problems go. Plan diff: those labels, bases and claims, and the placements the longer labels move (the front view's dimension band grows 2 mm on the spool; the spool's ø70 leader now runs along its silhouette, and three new leader-crosses-hole findings); SVG/PDF follow. macOS PNG hashes recorded; their stale Linux plan/svg/pdf overrides are removed, and Linux PNG (and any Linux byte override) is to be recorded by CI's record_single_sheet job. Re-recorded on the merged tree after J1's re-baseline (projection symbol) folded the earlier record.

k4-leader-rules.note: K4 (#43 item 2): the leader router's material re-entry is now the shared predicate (src/material.rs) over each solid's projected box rather than the part's whole box, its depth added to a re-entering candidate's length. On the two-body plate-and-pin assemblies (assembly_plate_pin default and two saved specs, hw_assembly_plate_pin_intent default and one saved spec) one callout's elbow, the front view's ø6 on the pin, moves 0.75 mm along its row (36.85 → 36.1 mm); its tip and label are unchanged. Plans and SVGs diffed against the base: only that leader moved; checked by eye at 2400 px. macOS record run; the Linux PNG needs CI's record_single_sheet.
